newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity National to buy GB Foods stake.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity National to buy GB Foods stake.

text.p: Fidelity National Financial Inc said Monday it had agreed to buy a 41 percent stake in GB Foods Corp, consisting of one million shares of common stock and 3.5 million common stock purchase warrants.
Of the 3.5 million warrants, 1.5 million are exercisable at $5 a share, one million are exercisable at $7 a share, and one million are exercisable at $7.50 a share.
In connection with the deal, William Theisen, George Kubat and Michael Scherr will resign as directors and officers of GB Foods.
William Foley II, Frank Willey and Andrew Puzder will fill the vacancies on the GB Foods' board.
Foley is chairman and chief executive of Fidelity and CKE Restaurants Inc and a director of Rally's Hamburgers Inc and Checkers Drive-In Restaurants Inc.
Willey is president and a director of Fidelity and a director of CKE Restaurants. Puzder is executive vice president and general counsel of Fidelity and CKE.
The company said it expects to close the deal in "the immediate future."
It also said it will not be involved in the day-to-day "operational complexities" involved in directly operating a large number of company-owned restaurants.
GB Foods operates Mexican quick-service restaurants under the name "The Green Burrito."
Headquartered in Irvine, California, Fidelity National Financial is the parent corporation of seven national insurance underwriters.
